description: This Java class 'PolicyQueryResponseSignalMapper' maps responses from policy query commands to signals within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter. It extends an abstract mapper class, implements response validation, topic path building, and payload enhancement based on the policy query response.

classes.name: PolicyQueryResponseSignalMapper
classes.description: The class maps policy query responses to signals, validating responses, creating topic paths, and enhancing payloads accordingly.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the response class name ends with 'response'; throws exception if not.

methods.name: getTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Builds a topic path specific to policies for the given response.

methods.name: enhancePayloadBuilder
methods.description: Populates the payload builder with status and entity information from the response.
